verdicts.reason: A has a sensible banner split: a full-width white logo bar, centred headline copy on the left and the CTA on the right. Its flaws are the orange divider sitting left-aligned under centred text, the CTA column floating with no grouping to the copy, and a dead navy band along the bottom. B's white logo panel stops at about 2/3 width with a navy strip above it, which looks like a rendering error. B's body copy is off-axis from the headline and jammed near the bottom edge, and a stray divider floats above the CTA.
